cards.title: Link shortener
cards.prompt: Design a link shortener for a social app with about a hundred million new links a month.
facts_if_asked: Read to write ratio is about one hundred to one.
follow_ups: How do you make short codes unique?
What happens when one link goes viral?
cards.twist: One link gets ten million clicks in a minute.
cards.interviewer_notes: Strong answers separate the read path and cache hot links.
